questions.prompt: Which statement skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next one?
questions.explanation: continue skips the remaining code in the current iteration and proceeds to the next loop iteration.

questions.prompt: Write a loop using continue to print only odd numbers from 1 to 5.
After continue executes, what happens next?
options: The loop moves to the next iteration
questions.explanation: continue immediately jumps to the next iteration, skipping the remaining body code.
